title: Twilio reports Q1 revenue up 20% YoY to $1.41B, vs. $1.34B est., and forecasts Q2 revenue above estimates; TWLO jumps 17%+ after hours (Reinhardt Krause/Investor's Business ...)
summary: Reinhardt Krause / Investor's Business Daily: Twilio reports Q1 revenue up 20% YoY to $1.41B, vs. $1.34B est., and forecasts Q2 revenue above estimates; TWLO jumps 17%+ after hours — Twilio (TWLO) stock popped after the communications software maker reported first-quarter earnings and revenue that topped consensus estimates.
